import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B62_TXT="""
   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0

M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2

rows=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n"); aas=rows[0].split(); B={}
for r in rows[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for b,v in zip(aas,p[1:]): B[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B.get((a,b),-4)
def nw_affine(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            v=sc(a,s2[j-1])
            c=(M[i-1,j-1]+v,Ix[i-1,j-1]+v,Iy[i-1,j-1]+v);k=int(np.argmax(c));M[i,j]=c[k];pM[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));Ix[i,j]=c[k];pX[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Iy[i,j]=c[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); A1=[];A2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if state==0: A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif state==1: A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1
        else: A1.append('-');A2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1
        if i==0 and j>0: state=2
        elif j==0 and i>0: state=1
        else: state=int(ns)
    return ''.join(reversed(A1)),''.join(reversed(A2))

s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist"})
def seqof(a): return s.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]
accs={"PP_2179 SpuA":"Q88KW0","PP_5298":"Q88C85","PP_3598":"Q88GW9","PP_0727":"Q88PX1",
      "E.coli PuuD":"P76038","P.aer SpuA PA0297":"Q9I6J4","Human GGH":"Q92820"}
SEQ={k:seqof(v) for k,v in accs.items()}; names=list(SEQ); n=len(names)
I=np.zeros((n,n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i,n):
        if i==j: I[i,j]=100; continue
        a,b=nw_affine(SEQ[names[i]],SEQ[names[j]])
        al=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!='-' and y!='-')
        idn=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x==y and x!='-')
        I[i,j]=I[j,i]=100*idn/al
D=pd.DataFrame(I.round(1),index=names,columns=names)
print(D.to_string())
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,6.0))
im=ax.imshow(I,cmap="viridis",vmin=20,vmax=100)
ax.set_xticks(range(n)); ax.set_xticklabels(names,rotation=40,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(n)); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=8)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        ax.text(j,i,f"{I[i,j]:.0f}",ha="center",va="center",color="white" if I[i,j]<65 else "black",fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Pairwise amino-acid identity (%), global Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62\nPeptidase C26 / PuuD-like proteins",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,label="% identity"); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
